title: I'm Coming
description: A discreet meeting between two passionate roll-players is interrupted by a burglar. After investigating, and being confronted by the intruder, things go from bad to worse, to much worse.

title: M4M: Motive for Murder
description: Hyderabad is on edge as a serial killer stages murders as famous paintings. ACP Krishna and journalist Radha investigate, uncovering links to a student and a principal, racing to stop the next planned killing.

title: S&M Hunter Begins
description: THE LEGEND BEGINS! This prequel to the pink cult hit S&M Hunter tells the origin story of how an average salary man became the world's first S&M superhero! How did he lose his eye? Why is bad girl Meg chasing him in the first place? And why did Maria become a masochist? Long out of print and hungered for by Pink Eiga fans the world over, Pink Eiga Inc. is proud to release the only true superhero movie that matters in a flooded market of comic book adaptations!

description: Rahne Jones and Travis Mills help people discover why their partners are hiding them from their families and friends.

title: Love N Success
description: Money changes everything.

title: Lipstick N' Lyrics
description: Singer-songwriters break down the lyrics from some of their most popular songs

title: Tricks 'n' Tracks
description: The series of magic, music, tricks and tips. With Paul Zenon , Sally Gray , resident robots Arbie, Adam and Eve, and Russ Stevens performing some dazzling illusions.

title: N of 1
description: An electronic parts salesman in Toronto with no medical training conceives an idea that could revolutionize medicine. A young woman living in the American South faced with an incurable disease takes him up on it, and the two set out on an international odyssey to realize the possibility of a cure.

title: N*Gen
description: The first Panafrican science show for kids and their families. N*Gen models new ways of learning, promotes a culture of curiosity and promotes positive gender norms.

title: Business N' Debt
description: Business N' Debt follows our protagonist Micah as he battles against all odds to create the number one business.

title: Fish n' Chips
description: A hard working Cypriot immigrant in London finally opens his very own chip shop. But his dream turns into a nightmare, as he seems to have overlooked one small detail: Cyprus just isn't London.

title: N Tha Mix
description: Weekly series featuring major label artists videos, interviews and in- studio sessions.

title: N da CutZ
description: Entertainment News Magazine Series which takes the audience behind the scenes n Showsat all major events, Red Carpet Premires and Runway Fashon Shows. This was a ten week special which became "In The Mix."

title: เมื่อดวงดาวส่งเขา\Nกลับมาอีกครั้ง
description: คุณหนูตาบอดหลินจืออี้กับหัวหน้าสายลับหลี่เจิ้งฮ่าว แต่งงานกันสายฟ้าแลบเพราะถูกครอบครัวเร่งเร้า คืนแรกที่จดทะเบียนสมรส หลินจืออี้ก็เผชิญหน้ากับคดีฆาตกรรมจนเกือบถูกฆ่าปิดปาก โชคดีที่ผู้รอดชีวิตอย่างเธอ สามารถแย่งชิงมรดกกลับมาจากพี่ชายต่างบิดาได้ โดยมีคนรักอย่างหลี่เจิ้งฮ่าวคอยช่วยเหลือ แต่ทว่า เนื่องจากอุบัติเหตุทางรถที่ถูกจัดฉาก ทำให้หลี่เจิ้งฮ่าวต้องตายเพราะปกป้องหลินจืออี้ และบริจาคกระจกตาให้เธอ ห้าปีต่อมา หลินจืออี้ที่กลับมามองเห็นได้อีกครั้ง กลับมาพร้อมลูกสาวเพื่อสอบสวนความจริงของอุบัติเหตุในตอนนั้น แต่กลับพบกับประธานหน้าหล่อแต่ใจร้ายอย่างหลี่เสวียนปิน การต่อสู้เพื่อฐานะและการต่อสู้ระหว่างตระกูลเศรษฐีจึงเริ่มขึ้น

Enquanto Henrique tenta reparar seu erro, ela prova que uma vítima pode se tornar protagonista.

title: O aittitos

title: O fovos

title: O Gorila
description: Afrânio is a retired voice actor. Lonely and tormented by memories of his childhood. In her small apartment, looking for a way to re-integrate into society.

title: O Rebelde e o Estudioso
description: Maya Hayes é uma aluna nota dez com um objetivo: estudar muito, escapar do pai violento e nunca mais olhar para trás. Mas ao buscar refúgio em um estúdio de tatuagem após uma surra, ela esbarra no rebelde do Colégio Oakridge, Jude Sinclair. Logo, a aluna exemplar e o garoto rico com um passado sombrio viram colegas de classe. As madrugadas viram segredos compartilhados, e os insultos dão lugar à compreensão. Aos poucos, enxergam além de suas armaduras e descobrem algo verdadeiro. Juntos, fazem um pacto: libertar-se, lutar e destruir tudo o que tenta derrubá-los.

title: O trellopenintaris
description: A failed businessman who accepts to pose as a rich ship owner to break into high-end social circles, falls for a wealthy widow, unbeknownst to him that his official fiancée is not prepared to lose him. Will she bring him to his senses?

title: O ouranokatevatos
description: Yearning to see his beloved family one last time to lend them a helping hand, a recently deceased paterfamilias asks dear God for a leave of absence; however, their scandalous misbehaviour is shocking. Can he help them get back on track?

title: O emporakos
description: An honest medical student, who sells newspapers to make ends meet, falls in love with an affluent young woman with big, sad eyes. But, a shameless theft taints his immaculate reputation. Can an orphaned pedlar help him clear his name?

title: O Debate
description: A chief editor of a newsroom and a TV host, who were married for a long time, must try to conciliate their personal distinct views while working together during the coverage of a political debate of great importance for the nation's future.

title: O filos mou o Lefterakis
description: Thodorakis is a womanizer who lies to his wife about having a friend who lives in Patra in order to cover his dirty business. What happens when this fake friend appears in front of him and the night before he is ready to go with his mistress?

title: O Assalto
description: Lucas is in trouble, he has only a week to pay he's debts to Gomez. So he comes up with a plan and forms a team to steal a necklace that contains potential clues to a hidden treasure.

title: Five-O
description: Two inept police officers, who have spent their entire lives wanting to appear on the show "Police Force", get more than they bargained for when an evil drug lord becomes falsely convinced that they are America's most badass cops.

title: O Casarão
description: An old house withers away at the heart of a village ripped in half by a road where cars no longer stop. During the dictatorship, this building was the most progressive Catholic seminary in Portugal. António, the front door neighbor, was brought up and raised a family in its shadow. Ever since the Dominican priests left, he has been its most faithful caretaker - keeper of ghosts, memories, and hallways now emptied of life. Abandoned for years, the town's former epicenter now hopes for a new life.

title: O Descarte
description: Claudia (Gloria Menezes) is a wealthy widow, she found in Bruno (Ronnie Von) a new love. But one morning, receives an anonymous letter containing a serious threat.

title: O Abhagi
description: A poor family lived in a small village far from the city. Batasa is the only girl in that family. She's dream is to marry a Raj Kumar, but it doesn't happen. On the other hand, Batasas father was always worried about his daughter marriage.

title: O Milionário
description: A sentimental comedy about toothpicks. A man makes and exchanges toothpicks for numerous products as he ignores money. He is called "The millionaire" and goes through the city, walking, meeting friends, Carlitos, the newspaper seller, and Celeste the lemon seller and living an innocent life, in contrast with the city, filled with traps.

title: O Desejo
description: Widowed one year ago, Eleonora, a 33-year-old woman from Sao Paulo's upper bourgeoisie, lives alone, unsuited to her husband's absence, an intellectual frustrated and torn between the need for transcendence and a strong sexual compulsion. The life of the couple, although not happy, was intense. However, the presence of her a long-time friend Ana Maria, just arrived from Paris, a middle-class university student, is staying at his house. The two go to the site of Eleonora and she remembers her life with Marcelo and his death by drowning.

title: O mestre e o Divino
description: Two filmmakers portray life in the village and in the mission of Sangradouro, Mato Grosso: Adalberto Heide, an eccentric German missionary, that soon after the contact with the Indians, in 1957, starts to film with his Super-8 camera; and Divino Tserewahu, a young Xavante filmmaker, that produces films for television and cinema festivals since the 90's. Shifting between complicity, competition, irony and affect, they give life to their historical records, revealing peculiar back-stages of indigenous catechizing in Brazil...

title: Patrolman P
description: In 1971 the Knapp Commission, entrusted to expose corruption in the New York Police Department, faces a major problem. They have little physical evidence - their main source, Frank Serpico, won't wear a wire. They finally strike gold when a corrupt cop named William Phillips agrees to become their undercover agent, in exchange for immunity from a bribery charge. The evidence he eventually collects leads directly to the indictment of thirty New York cops. But the tables quickly turn when Phillips himself is convicted of a double-homicide. Three decades later and still in prison Phillips claims he's the victim of a massive police conspiracy.

title: Jhong, Vhong at Kim, nagpagalingan ng joke
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Vice ibinahagi ang pangarap para sa relasyon nila ni Ion
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Pak na pak ang mga kandidatang tumalak sa Miss Q and A Weekly Finals. Dahil sa malakas na cheer ng Madang People, napa-"and I thank you" sina Elthon Bequio, Trixie Gomez, Gabriela Duevall, Queen Sam Ri, Freda, at Kathryn Fernando Poe, Jr.

Ang mga accla, nagbardagulan at bumuo ng kani-kanilang grupo. Pero at the end of the competition, nangingibabaw pa rin sa kanila ang nahanap na bagong sisterhood... at may nahanap din na pag-ibig? Si Gabriela, na-love at first sight sa 'poganda' na si Queen Sam Ri. At totoo ba ang balita na may isang lasing na kandidata?!

Ang Top 4 na sina Sam Ri, Elthon, Freda, at Gabriela ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At mula sa apat, dalawa lang ang nag-face off sa Beklamation. It's Sam Ri versus Elthon sa katanungan na, "Sa panahon ngayon anong mas nakakatakot, katangahan o kasamaan?"

Talak ni Sam Ri, mas nakakatakot ang katangahan dahil ito ang dahilan kung bakit marami ang nabibiktima ng fake news. "May mga taong matatalino pero nagtatanga-tangahan kaya nadadakip sila at napapaniwala ng mali," sabi ni Sam Ri.

Mula NCR, sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang Madlang Players na nangtatrabaho sa printing shops. May isang player ba na magpapa-tarpaulin ng "congrats" dahil na-hit ang jackpot?

Ay, nakaka-in love talaga! Nakisali pa sweet-sweet-an sina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga, na pinakilig ang Madlang People sa kanilang 'rainy moment' na eksena!

Pagkatapos ng It's Giving, You Gotta Lyric, at Laro Laro Pick rounds, ang joy ay kumapit kay player Joy.

title: Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa Miss Q&A
description:
What doesn't kill you makes you stronger, at sa bawat pagsubok ay mas tumatatag ang character. Mula sa Bahay ni Kuya, balik-“Showtime” na si Cianne Dominguez, hawak muli ang mikropono, slay kung slay sa pagpe-perform sa entablado. Group hug para kay Cianne!

Kung ang mood mo ay hindi kagandahan, mga beki ay may hatid kaming bonggang katatawanan. Sa talas ng isip at husay sa talakan, ang Miss Q&A candidates na ang bahalang magpagaan ng 'yong pakiramdam.

Sina Magdalena Fox, Maria Divina Bulawan Gil, at Yems Deligario Espinola, nagpalitan ng mga hirit. Si Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa kanyang pagpapakatotoo at transformation, at sa aktingan niya with Vhong Navarro.

Huwag hayaang malunod sa kalungkutan, sumabay sa alon ng saya at tawanan. Mula sa Dagat-Dagatan, Navotas, ang Madlang Players ay nakipagsapalaran, at baka sa Laro Laro Pick ay makabingwit pa ng malaking papremyo at kasiyahan.

Sa Act-Song round, ang script nila ni Darren Espanto, hindi kinaya ni Jackie Gonzaga sa kanilang aktingan. From one role to another, si Darren 'social distancing' pa rin ang gusto. Ayaw "madamay" kay hindi na lang daw muna siya magmo-move closer kay Cianne.

Sa jackpot round, si Aichelle ang sumabak sa larong may halong kaba. Ang Li-Pot offer na P25,000, tinanggap niya para siguradong may maihahanda sa darating na Pasko para sa pamilya. May panghihinayang nga lang na naramdaman si Aichelle dahil alam pala niya ang sagot sa P150,000 na POT question.

title: SexBomb Jopay, sumali sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Napahugot ang madlang people sa pagbisita ng bandang Mayonnaise at sa kanilang performance ng “Bakit, Pt. 2.” 'Nag-spread' din sila ng good vibes nang makisabay sa trending “Meme” dance challenge!

Ang kandidata na mabagal sa pindutan at waley sa talakan, siya naman ang uuwing luhaan. Buti na lang palaban at ginalingan nina "Miss Q and A" JC Ibale, Anxji Rose, at Bon Joey Trinidad.

Habang kinikilala ng hosts ang tatlong ladies, pagandahan din sila ng mga joke entries. Ang starting lineup ay sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro, pero 'di nagtagal, si Vhong ang unang napatalsik dahil sa joke niyang not-so matinik. First substitution of the day!

Chance na rin ito ng ibang hosts na sumabak sa "Miss Q and A." Maya-maya pa, nasubok naman ang husay ni Teddy Corpuz. Pero hindi pa man nagsisimula ang banter, parang may "issue" detected agad. Biro ni Meme, huwag gumigilid-glid si Teddy dahil baka magreklamo ito sa blocking, tapos ang netizens umariba na naman sa bashing.

Back to the pageant, unang pumaslak sa next round si JC, habang sina Anxji at Bon Joey ay nagbangayan tungkol sa "eulogy." Kaloka, mga teh! Pero pagkatapos ng mahabang diskusyon, si Bon Joey ang umabante sa Wit Lang at tumalak sa harap ng buong nation.

Kapag swerte ang bumagsak, huwag manghihina. Baka jackpot ang naghihintay sa players mula Marikina! POT money kaya ay maiuuwi nila?

Mukhang may dalang swerte talaga kapag ikaw ang first interviewee, dahil madalas, sa jackpot round, sila rin ang umaabante. Araw talaga ito ni Emon dahil siya ang naglaro sa POT o Li-POT round.

title: NAHILO! Pokwang, NILARO ang comment sa Miss Q&A
description:
Kilig harana ang hatid ng bisitang si John Rex Baculfo, who shared that it feels nice to be back onstage singing his new single, na tungkol sa mga taong patuloy na umaasa. Napahugot si John Rex doon ah!

Sa tanungan at talakan, bawal ang sabaw at lutang. Dapat mabilis mag-isip at mas okay rin 'yung chukchak na may halong tapang. Tatlong reyna muli ang sumabak sa "Miss Q and " daily round sa "It's Showtime."

Maraming baon sina Lianne Marie Etorma, Jerica Arboleda Ibarra, at Reign Manzano Gaboy pagdating sa kalokohan, syempre pati na rin sa talakan. Si Lianne nga ba ang totoong panganay ni Ogie Alcasid? "Kalokalike" ang hatol ng mga nagmamasid.

Si Jerica naman, pitong taon lamang nang magsimulang sumabak sa pageants. Kahit madalas talo, bakit hindi siya nagasasawang sumali sa mga patimpalak na ganito? At matapos malotlot ni Lianne, si Ogie nagbigay ng words of wisdom.

Sa "Wit Lang" round, nabunot ni Reign ang tanong na, “Sino ang anak ng mag-asawang sampal?” Laro rin ang tanong na napili ni Jerica, “Sa iyong palagay, mabaho ba ang hininga ng kaututang dila?”

Mapapaisip ka talaga sabay matatawa katulad ng na-feel nina hurado Pokwang, River Joseph, at Nicole Cordoves. Si 'Mamang' Pokwang, nilaro rin ang comment. Nahilo raw siya sa sagot ng isang kandidata, na sa sobrang lalim parang pwede nang hukayin.

Mga taga-Dela Paz, Antipolo, Rizal ang sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Parang rollercoaster ang kuwentuhan ng hosts kay player Lizel, na naging 'judge' pa sa isang impromptu papogian portion ng male hosts. Sino nga ba ang pinakagwapo? Nanguna sa ranking si Vhong Navarro, at si Ogie Alcasid naman ang inilagay sa dulo, kaya siya ang naging target ng panunukso.

Umabante sa jackpot round si player Monique, isang volunteer tanod sa kanilang barangay. Para siguradong may maiuuwi, dedma na si Monique sa P400,000 POT question at tinanggap ang P30,000 offer na malaking tulong na raw para sa needs ng pamilya.

title: River Joseph, hurado sa Miss Q and A!
description:
Good music ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, at Yannie Paul Basical. Pinagsama-sama ng limang powerhouse singers ang kanilang winning voices sa isang performance na perfect pampagaan ng mood bago sumabak sa weekend.

Nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" for a second chance sa Miss Q&A Resbakulawan sina Nadie Marie Fernandez, Miukie, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Tumatak si Nadie dahil sa tawa niyang kakaiba. Natandaan naman ni Vice Ganda ang unique na pangalang Miukie. But arguably the most remarkable of the three, si Belle, na binansagang 'Sofronia Vasquez' ni Meme. Siya 'yung kandidata na sa pagpindot ay nahuli pero sa talak ang daming sinasabi. Hirit niya, baka pinabalik siya dahil awa, pero itinanggi 'yan ni Vice Ganda. Sabi ni Meme, nabitin daw ang lahat sa talak noon ni Belle.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Belle ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan mayroon silang tatlumpung segundo para sagutin ang tanong tungkol sa epekto ng pagkawala ng taong minamahal. Naging emosyonal si Nadie na inalala ang nawalang pamangkin, at galing din sa puso ang chukchak ni Belle na nagpahayag naman ng pagmamahal sa ina.

Dumayo sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang mga taga-Barangay Batis, San Juan City. Hindi pasyal ang sadya nila kundi mga challenges na pwedeng magdala sa kanila sa POT money.

Nakipagkuwentuhan ng hosts sa tricycle driver na si Viomar. Pero ang nagpakitang-gilas, walang iba kundi si Amy Perez, na daig pa ang tricycle driver sa kanyang knowledge. Ang mga pasikot-sikot na kalye sa Maynila, kabisado ni Tyang!

Si Edwin ang nakarating sa Jackpot Round. Bago pa man ihain ang Li-Pot offer, buo na ang loob niyang ilaban ang ₱400,000 POT question anuman ang ialok sa kanya.

title: MC at Lassy, 'NAGSABUNUTAN' sa Miss Q&A
description:
Sa "It's Showtime" entablado they're always getting fiercer and fiercer with their new single "Spider." Here comes DNA, ready to slay! Ang singing trio nina Tasha, Julia at Ezri, nagpasikat sa harap ng Madlang People.

Ang pag-ibig, wala 'yan sa edad o kasarian. Kapag tumibok ang puso, huwag nang itago. Ipagsigawan ang damdamin! Ang feelings, aminin! Parang mga Miss Q and A candidates na hindi nagpapigil sa self-expression at pagtalak para marinig ng buong nation.

Mega slay sa pagrampa at talakan na havey ang queens na sina Francyne Astronomia, Kiana Ortega, at Dha-Dha Aringo.

Si Francyne na softie girlie, idol si Overtime Diva, Miss Trina. As a student, hate na hate niya 'yung mga kagrupo na palaging late. Si candidate 3, Dha-Dha, ipinakilala ang kanyang girlfriend of 9 years na si RR.

Sina Dha-Dha at Kiana ang umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talino at creativity sa mga tanong na mapaglaro't nakakalito. Mas nagustuhan nina hurados Max Collins, Michael Sager, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kiana, kaya siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Humataw nang wagas at napasigaw nang malakas ang Madlang Players mula San Jose, Navotas. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, malakas din ba ang swerte nila?

Malakas talaga ang chemistry ng DaCkie! Madlang People ay kinilig sa eksena nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. May pananagutan na?! Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro), nami-miss si Memerimar (Vice Ganda). Sobrang longing naman 'yan! Ang ating leading man, naghanap ng bagong Memerimar—walang iba kundi si Ryan Bang!

Sina Enteng at Mayang, parehong naka-survive sa You Gotta Lyric. Pero sa 'Laro Laro Pick,' one point lang ang kinailangan ni Mayang para umabante sa jackpot round kung saan nagkaroon siya ng pagkakataon na manalo ng P150,000.

title: WITTY! Vhong at Jhong, sinubukan ang mga tanong sa Miss Q&A
description:
Weekend na, mga accla, kaya come out na sa lungga. Huwag puro "seen" sa GC kapag may nag-invite sa party-party lalo na't Pride Month celebration today. Join sa occasion ang "It's Showtime" family at ang mga weekly finalists ng "Miss Q and A."

From their daily round panalo, nagharap-harap sa panibagong talakan ang limang kandidata this Sabado—Shanaya De Guzman, Lixa Labbuanan, Lucky Robles Collins, Mama Mama, at Andrea Lim.

Na-challenge ang brain cells ng mga 'accla' sa Tumpak Ganern round, partikular na sa tanong tungkol sa pangalan ng isang senador. Pagkatapos ng Round 1, naligwak si Lixa, at ang apat naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan bumawi sila at pinalakpakan.

Nagtuloy-tuloy ang 'chukchakan' sa final round kung saan sina Mama Mama at Andrea ang naglaban. Iisang tanong lang ang ibinato sa kanila: "Anong materyal na bagay ang ireregalo mo sa nanay mong pagod?" "Ointment" ang sagot ni Mama Mama, at "bulaklak" naman para kay Andrea.

Nakisaya sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena ang mga residente ng Caloocan para subukan ang kanilang kapalaran! 'Napuruhan' si Teddy Corpuz sa aktingan. Paano ba naman, ang mga punchline, parang personalan. Kinarir naman ni Ogie Alcasid ang eksena bilang 'witch' na inakit si Brent Manalo. Kung may Best Actor sa araw na 'to, si Chief of OPM na 'yun, panigurado!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa lahat ng games, bumunot ng isang maswerteng eliminated player. At 'yun ay si Jomar! Para sa pamilya, si Jomar, hindi na sumugal pa at tinanggap na ang P25,000 offer sa Li-Pot.

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Miss Q&A Rexy, UMIYAK nang matalo
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

Sina Dha-Dha at Kiana ang umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talino at creativity sa mga tanong na mapaglaro't nakakalito. Mas nagustuhan nina hurados Max Collins, Michael Sager, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kiana, kaya siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Humataw nang wagas at napasigaw nang malakas ang Madlang Players mula San Jose, Navotas. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, malakas din ba ang swerte nila?

Malakas talaga ang chemistry ng DaCkie! Madlang People ay kinilig sa eksena nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. May pananagutan na?! Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro), nami-miss si Memerimar (Vice Ganda). Sobrang longing naman 'yan! Ang ating leading man, naghanap ng bagong Memerimar—walang iba kundi si Ryan Bang!

Sina Enteng at Mayang, parehong naka-survive sa You Gotta Lyric. Pero sa 'Laro Laro Pick,' one point lang ang kinailangan ni Mayang para umabante sa jackpot round kung saan nagkaroon siya ng pagkakataon na manalo ng P150,000.

title: Jogos Bons Q Vc Não Conhece - Colônia Contra Ataca
Miss Q&A candidate, dumami ang 'boyfriend' sa studio
description:
Sabi nga nila, after the rain there's a rainbow na naghihintay. Pero hindi pa man natatapos ang buhos ng ulan, kinulayan na ni Heath Jornales ang ating mga buhay sa karisma niyang taglay. Isang kilig harana at magandang balita ang hatid ng "PBB Collab 2.0" Kapuso 2nd Big Placer.

Nagningning ang tatlong kandidata na nagpatalasan ng wit sa Miss Q and A segment. Ready to dominate the 'queendom' of talak sina Xantie, Kendra, at Lancy Empleo. 

Rain or shine, tuloy rin ang puksaan at kulitan ng paborito nating trio sa FUNanghalian, sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Gets na ni Meme Vice ang galawan ng mga kaibigan, kaya nang mapag-usapan ang mga ibong 'parrot,' si Meme na mismo ang bumitaw ng punchline at tinawag ang sarili bilang 'panot.' 

Samantala, sa Wit Lang round ang punta nina Xantie at Lancy kung saan hinarap nila ang magkaibang pageant questions. Bahagyang kinabahan ang mga kandidata, but the effort is appreciated. Besides, nagbigay ng advice si hurado Nicole Cordoves for their improvement. 

Hindi lang candidates ang nag-attempt na sungkitin ang puso ng judges, dahil maging si Ryan Bang ay give na give sa mga jokes as his way to the heart of hurado Max Collins. Kaya para makuha ang loob ng mga kaibigan ni Max, nagpa-impress na rin ang cutie Koreano pati sa ibang hurado.

Kung malamig ang panahon, mainit naman na pinaglabanan sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang POT money na P250,000. Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si player Aubrey, isang cashier na nagbahagi ng karanasan sa mga scammer. Malakas naman ang dating ni player Darren, kaya si Jackie Gonzaga biglang longing. 

Sinuwerte nang todo si Maricel, na nabunot ang pangalan para sa jackpot round matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players. Naging maingat si Maricel sa pagpili, at naging wais hanggang sa huli.

title: Meme Vice, naguluhan sa pagkatao ni Miss Q&A Rexy
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

title: Nutridamus! Vice natawa sa mga sagot sa Miss Q&A
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nangakong babalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: R. Kelly: The Verdict
description: The verdict is in; R Kelly has been found guilty. The alleged crimes are some of the most heinous, graphic and disturbing ever to go before a court. Guilty on nine counts including racketeering, kidnapping, bribery, sex trafficking and sexual exploitation of a child. For many, this was justice that took far too long to manifest. For decades, there were reports of dangerous and corrupt behaviour haunting the king of RnB. Now the king has fallen and the autopsy of his impossible sequence of events began. The real story is almost too shocking to believe.

title: You're Not Supposed to Be Here

title: Daily T
description:
Thomas J Elliott is a master filmmaker who has worked all over the world, creating multi award winning projects for some of the world's leading global brands, from Coca-Cola to Microsoft, Manulife, global advertising agencies and anywhere and everywhere in between.

Beyond his work in content and commercials, he has directed documentaries, television series and more recently he has branched off into feature films and streaming content.

He is the author of five award-winning, best-selling books on visual content and visual storytelling.

In addition to this he is a regular contributor to leading educational workshops and events all over the world, from massive events like VidCon to private workshops for universities, think tanks and global brands and agencies.

In this first of its kind series created exclusively for social media platform LinkedIn, Thomas shares his thoughts on crafting and creating films and visual content as well as a deep dive into the directing process that covers everything from selecting the right material, to working with actors and crew, on set process and getting your work completed and out there.

The series provides a unique insight into an established working director, his process, the reality of working with brands, agencies, production companies, actors and production partners.

It shows the audience real world examples they can use in their work immediately to improve the quality of their work and their output.

Episodes are released weekly Monday to Friday on LinkedIn and across other channels.

description:
This film takes you behind the scenes in the timeline of a dynamic and ambitious young conceptual artist, from his "Clearance Sale" of a lifetime's work at ArtLA, to weeks of dispensing therapy at the Whitney Biennial, to a near-death injury on Miami's Biscayne Boulevard and the mindset that followed. Includes detailed on-site action at art installations and performances, with spirited opinions from celebrated artists and art world professionals about measuring the success and value of conceptual art.

The film is narrated with spirited, candid commentary by important artists and art professionals such as legendary conceptual / performance artists Marina Abramovic and Vito Acconci on the highs and lows of a conceptual art world with uniquely difficult career choices, by famed New York Magazine Senior Art Critic Jerry Saltz on what is and isn't conceptual art and how Rodriguez measures up, author Steven Henry Madoff about Rodriguez service aesthetics achievements, and celebrated New York art blogger C-Monster.net, who experienced the artist, face- to-face and alone, locked inside his therapy cube.

description: Scott, a smug Montreal lawyer, searches for the girl of his dreams whom he met briefly four summers previously, when she was in a sports car on a tiny ferry going to an island in the St. Lawrence. Meanwhile, his girlfriend Bonnie is pressuring him to marry her.

title: Chopped U
description: Chopped U pits two young food aficionados in direct culinary competition to battle it out in the kitchen. Contestants are given 30 minutes and four mystery ingredients to create a delicious and unique dish, to be judged by Lazarus Lynch.

title: U zemlji cudesa
description: Still today, years after the war, some regions are contaminated with broken families, poverty, crime and low-grade uranium. In the middle of nowhere in Western Herzegovina, at a NATO military training range, a nine-year-old girl called Alica, together with her uncle Valentin, collects shells and scraps of grenades to sell on the black market. Valentin dies of cancer, Alica's diagnosis is not good but there's no money for therapy. Alica's journey through the Land of Wonders begins.

title: U oluji
description: Rose is a young woman who lost her husband in WW2, leaving her and their daughter behind. She gets close with his good-natured brother Drago. However, an unscrupulous smuggler Vincenzo is always around him, and the things get tough for the couple.

title: U registraturi
description: Tells the story of Ivica Kicmanovic, from his childhood to his eventual downfall caused by femme fatale Laura.

title: Stoyne u kostenurka
description: Stoine has been called up and is on his way to the barracks accompanied by his father Rangel. Some tanks appear. Rangel watches them. He recalls the war in which he took part and regrets that no such "tortoises" were available at the time. Stoine explains that money is needed for purchase all of this. Rangel leaves Stoine in the hands of sergeant mayor and promises to buy a tank for his son. At home he takes a small money bag from a chest. In the bank a clerk counts the money for the rearmament of the country... The hatches of one tank open and Rangel and Stoine appear. The father begins to fire with a machine gun... But all this turns to be a dream - Rangel's wife funds him clutching the bedstead. Rangel tells her everything about the "tortoise". The two beam with satisfaction.

title: Sparkle U
description: Each story of Sparkle U reflects the social media feeds of Filipino youth nowadays as well as their struggles and issues in life. A self-contained miniseries following different sets of characters and storylines, each narrative is related to the fictional universe called Sparkle University. Sparkle University is a conservative, parent-funded, all-inclusive university that offers educational programs from elementary, high school, senior high school, to undergraduate studies. Can the youth of today, who is greatly exposed to social media, survive the real world where people can't just mute or delete someone in their life? How can they solve their problems if their parents don't understand where they are coming from?

title: Sinbad: Where U Been?
description: Sinbad is back and Live at a Comedy Central Concert Special with comedy and music.

title: Bozic u Becu
description: A young violinist who plays at the war front decides to join his parents in Vienna after his best friend loses an arm during Serb attack.

title: Pucnji u Marseju
description: King Alexander and French Foreign Minister Louis Barthou were assassinated on October 9, 1934, in Marseille, France. Film 'Bullets over Marseille' follows the trial against the accomplices of the assassin.

title: U Kunt Nog Stemmen
description: Ten years after participating in the very first Dutch Idols, the ten former finalists of this immense popular talent show come together to share stories. They haven't seen each other as a group all this time. Expecting to hear only happy updates from each other, they are surprised to find out every one of them has been struggling with the same kind of issues all this time. Becoming famous over night due to a TV show and then having to find your own way in life without this fame, has proven to be a challenge. Director Emma Westermann lets them tell their story in a very personal and honest way - behind the glitter and glamour, this documentary shows the reality of a reality show.

title: P.S.I. Luv U
description: Wanda Talbert is a New York con artist. After being caught by the NYPD, she agrees to help them nail a criminal. What they didn't tell her was that she needed to testify against him, and that will not take place for a few years, which means that she must remain in custody until then, which doesn't make her happy because it means that she needs to put her moneymaking schemes and con-games on hold. They send her to Palm Springs, where an ex-federal marshal runs a security agency where she will work while hiding. Also accompanying her is Joey Paciorek, a New York police officer who will protect her--and make sure she doesn't bolt. They pretend to be married couple Cody and Dani Powell, which won't be easy since they don't like each other.

title: U nás v Kocourkove
description: At Kocourkov railway station, an escaped fraudster Ferdinand Kaplan arrives and is welcomed, by mistake, as a hero. Very quickly Kaplan gets into his new role and is elected mayor. Things start happening for the good of the town.

title: U Game?

title: Love U Muddu [Hindi]

title: Street Fighter II: V S1-S2
description: Based off of the video game, on an island off the coast of Japan, Ryu, a martial artist, was given an invitation and some American money from his friend Ken Masters, telling him to come to the United States. Ryu arrives in San Francisco and Ken picks him up from the airport. Only to find out that Ken is rich and a defined martial artist himself. One night both Ryu and Ken were out scouting San Francisco for bars. Then, Ken flirts with somebody's girlfriend and gets into a fight. Ken has defeated the person. Only to find out that it was a partner of Air force pilot Guile. Ryu fights him, but was defeated easily. Ken then finds Guile and was too defeated. Ken then realizes that guile was a fighter of thew likes that Ryu and Ken has not seen before, Guile was a Street Fighter. So, both Ryu and Ken decided to set out to the world to learn the ways of the street fighter. Then, they get tangled up into a conspiracy involving a criminal organization.

title: Dai Sentai Goggle-V
description: The Dark Science Empire Desdark launches its scheme for world conquest from their Destopia Castle in Germany. Dr. Hideki Hongo, founder of the Future Science Laboratory, is saved from one of their attacks by world class explorer Kenichi Akama. Using his Computer Boys and Girls, Hongo recruits five people, including Kenichi, to form the Dai Sentai Goggle-V (Goggle 5), the only force capable of stopping Desdark.

title: Yakout W Anber
description: The series revolves around the family of Moulay Ahmed, one of the most famous merchants in Casablanca, a father of six daughters, who dreams of having a son who will inherit his wealth and lineage. Moulay Ahmed's wife, Anber, discovers that the gender of her fetus is a girl again.

title: Nevertheless: The Shapes of Love
description: Ren Kosaka, a young talented artist, arrives in Kamakura, Japan for a temporary lecturer position. His aura attracts people, yet he keeps distance. When he meets a woman, his emotions change despite knowing the potential consequences.

title: W pustyni i w puszczy
description: Fourteen year old Polish boy Stas Tarkowski and eight year old Nel Rawlison from England are kidnapped as the hostages by Arabic fanatics and taken to their religion leader. Then they manage to escape and try to return to their fathers. Children have a lot of dangerous adventures, meet two Black kids; Kali and Mea, who also help them, make a friendship with an elephant and help one Black's tribe. Finally they manage to return. Based on great novel, the same title by Nobel receiver (for all his literary output) Henryk Sienkiewicz.

title: Happy Ending
description: A new massage therapist Ina catches client Joel's interest. As he persistently pursues her, she's uncertain about giving him the romantic conclusion he desires.

title: Salma w Sari
description: Salma and Sari is about two young Palestinians who find themselves in a situation they weren't ready for. The series is set in East Jerusalem, where life under Israeli occupation is stressful and pressure leads to aggression. Their friends and family make it difficult for them to make their own decisions and follow their dreams. Salma is only eighteen. She grew up without a father, and pressure on her mother to protect Salma from society grows. Salma has a passion for photography, and struggles to convince her mother to support her goals. She has to take matters into her own hands, to follow her dreams, whatever the cost. Sari didn't go to college and works at his family business. He's good at what he does, but that's not good enough for his family. As he reaches the age of twenty four, his family insists it's time to marry and start a family. Sari's friends have different plans for him. They are young, bored, and love cars. And you know what that means - trouble. This creative drama for social change is set in East Jerusalem and other areas in the West Bank.

title: Minna w Fina
description: A husband travels with his wife outside the country to have her treated for her illness while the children remain alone in the house. However, their problems increase due to their lack of discipline, which raises the concern of the parents, and here begins a conflict between the two generations after the arrival of the grandparents.

title: Aniol w szafie
description: Soundman Jan is a respected and sensitive professional. But his internal life is shadowed by a secret from his past.

title: Dimension W
description: In the year 2072, the world's energy problems seem solved by a network of cross-dimensional electric-field inductors called "coils" that extract energy from a seemingly infinite source.

title: masakra w
description:
Amerykański western w wersji z polskim lektorem - Masakra w Dragoon Wells.

Oficer kawalerii jako jedyny ocalał z ataku Indian. Wraz z wozem pełnym więźniów i skazańców, przemierza terytorium wrogo nastawionych Indian.

Masakra w Dragoon Wells (1957)
Reżyser: Harold D. Schuster
Scenarzyści: Warren Douglas, Oliver Drake
W rolach głównych: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman
Gatunek: western
Kraj: USA
Język: angielski
Data premiery: 28 lutego 1958 r. (RFN)
Miejsca kręcenia: Kanab, Utah, USA

Fabuła:
Oficer kawalerii, jedyny ocalały z ataku Indian, wraz z wagonem więźniów przemierza wrogie tereny indiańskie.

Recenzje:
"„Nie jestem obiektywny, bo mam z tym filmem osobiste wspomnienia. Jako nastolatek lubiłem kolorowe westerny z popularnymi aktorami. Dziś wolę czarno-białe klasyki. Latem 1956 roku przypadkiem trafiłem na plan zdjęciowy tego filmu w Utah. Widziałem, jak kręcono kilka scen z O'Keefe’em i Cabotem. Później obejrzałem film w kinie i zaskoczyło mnie, że fabuła jest bardziej złożona niż w typowych westernach z lat 50. Nie ma tu jednego bohatera – to historia wielu postaci. Polecam każdemu, kto lubi filmy z dobrze napisanymi postaciami i solidną realizacją. Szkoda, że trudno znaleźć ten film na DVD.”
Autor: hitt_dave na IMDb.com
 

„To nie jest prosty western. Kapitan kawalerii i więźniowie muszą współpracować, by przetrwać na terenie Indian. Aktorstwo stoi na wysokim poziomie, reżyseria jest solidna, a muzyka buduje napięcie. Film ogląda się z prawdziwą przyjemnością.”
Autor: bux na IMDb.com

title: X Factor 2
description: Moyeen and Mahfi are back on their vast journey to Cox's Bazar and Teknaf and on the way they both stumble upon two girls who they wish to be their life partners.

title: Vares X
description: Vares gets a desperate call from his friend Kyy, who needs saving. While Vares is saving his friend, the daughter of a new family of private detectives is kidnapped. Vares has to gamble with higher stakes than ever before. Events begin to link up with the parties of a mysterious sex cult and a showdown in the underworld. Who can Jussi Vares finally save?

title: Ben X Jim S1-S2
description: Benjamin is given an ultimatum to become financially independent or move to America. Meanwhile, his old neighbor and childhood friend, Jimson, is moving home to quarantine with his family. How will their story end once their paths cross?

title: Vagabundo y millonario
description: After failing to locate a kidnapped millionaire, the chief of police fools an identical-looking tourist to pose as the kidnapped gentleman to fool the criminals into letting him loose.

title: Héroes y demonios
description: Two young men meet at a psychiatric hospital, where they become friends willing to fight against injustice.

title: Aquí y Allá
description: "AQUÍ": Pedro returns home to a small mountain village in Guerrero, Mexico after years of working in the US. He finds his daughters older, and more distant than he imagined. His wife still has the same smile. Having saved some earnings from two trips to the US, he hopes to now finally make a better life with his family, and even to pursue his dreams on the side by starting a band: Copa Kings. He cherishes the everyday moments with his family. "ALLÁ": The villagers think this year's crop will be bountiful. There is also good work in a growing city an hour away. But the locals are wise to a life of insecurity, and their thoughts are often of family members or opportunities far away, north of the border. While working in the fields, Pedro meets and begins to mentor a teenager who dreams of the US. That place somehow always feels very present, practically knocking at the door. "Aquí y Allá" is a story about hope, and the memories and loss of what we leave behind.

title: Vida y color
description: Teenaged Fede is trying to overcome his family's peculiarities--a sister's unsatisfied wedding; a grandfather's refusal to talk to his best friend; a family friend coping with Down's Syndrome, and then there are the bullies.

title: Samy y yo
description: Samy Goldstein, a writer for a television program, is surrounded by an oppressive female environment. Then decides to resume his passion for literature. Meet Mary, a beauty in crisis. From there a series of misunderstandings will happen.

title: Tú y yo
description: The Mrs., an old widow, and Aridia, her maid, live in isolation in a house in Santo Domingo where they have domestic chores to keep them occupied. Their relationship is tense, but as the end of the day, they know they only have each other.

title: Donramon y Perchita
description: Online series about the adventures of DonRamon and Perchita

title: Y++
description: A series of sketches about the miseries of life in the 21st century and its effects on the human condition.

title: Ati y Mindiwa
description: Two sisters Ati and Mindhiva; They are part of the Arhuaca tribe, a Colombian indigenous culture. Their dream is to continue with their university studies. They have no money and it is impossible for them to enter in to the National University... Nevertheless they won't give up the fight and theta will search into other forms of education. Will they be able to find the strenght to continue pursuing their dream? We will follow them into their adventure.

title: La Habana y Barcelona. Esplendor y Ruinas
description: Havana and Barcelona have much in common. The Catalan Indians built extensively in Havana and you can also see many similarities in Barcelona's Paseo de Gracia or in the uptown's grand houses. Nowadays, Barcelona has become home to many talented Cubans: artists, musicians, doctors and unique but ordinary people. In this film, they sing, dance and explain their experiences in Barcelona, and how much they miss their own land. They get excited, cry and laugh. They tell us how they have adapted to life in this brotherly country, but different, colder and more formal. They talk about the special period caused by the fall of the Berlin Wall, and also about medicine and Afro-Cuban culture.

title: Esposa y amante
description: Luisa's daughter has attempted suicide. While attending the clinic and, looking at the state of her daughter, she remembers the first happy years of her marriage to Peter, a popular and friendly sports journalist. Soon after came the first deceptions of her husband.

title: Cabeza y corazón
description: The only time the Spanish women's wheelchair basketball team participated in the Paralympic Games was in Barcelona in 1992, when Spain was granted the place as the host country without the need to qualify. Twenty-four years later, for the first time in history, the team once again has the chance to compete in the Paralympics. Despite having fewer resources than other countries' teams, the Spanish team is making its way against all odds in the international competitions. An intimate, player's-eye view follows the physical and psychological journey leading to the team's historic qualification for the Paralympic Games in Tokyo 2020-21.

title: Donaire y Esplendor
description: In the traditional carnival of the small town called Las Tablas, there are two rival streets: Up Street and Down Street. A young couple, after an unexpected encounter at the airport, fall hopelessly in love.

title: Marino y Esmeralda
description: Marino, 18, a young foreign film student, meets Esmeralda, 20, a student and a painter, in whom he finds the muse he always wanted for his camera. Soon he sees himself wanting to be what she is to him: her muse.

title: Aquí y ahora
description: A modern dancer must learn to juggle love, family, and her career while she auditions for a prestigious foreign dance company.

title: Pancho y Silpancho
description: Two truck drivers meet each other for the hazards of life in Santa Cruz, make a good friendship in the city of Cochabamba and travel throughout Bolivia and have their adventures with Treme, Cassandra and other characters.

title: Nacional y Popular
description: The life's story and militancy of the members of the Cooperative of stream's cleaning New Hope and Progress, formed by young and (and not such much) militants of the Movimiento Evita in Malvinas Argentinas , a Gran Buenos Aires town The work in the river, the activities in the district and discussion panels is the starting point, so that the companions can analyze the Conjunture of their political process and the roll that militancy and working class play today. From 2001's Crisis, to the triumph of Cristina Kirchner in the national elections, happening through the Town or Corporations discussion Resolution 125 generated, the negative mass media vision of the citizen protest, to the Nestor Kirchner's funeral the documentary recalls the Won and Lost Battle s this last eight years and the way to consolidate a nation for all.

title: Rotos y Descosidos
description: Where reality inspires fiction.

title: 101-y kilometr
description: A semiautobiographical film about a newly released prisoner who dreams of becoming a writer.

title: Seis y medio
description: In Six and a half a man and a woman debate, amaze each other, discover love and ponder on it from a fresh perspective: from a 6.5 level. It represents an ironic and unabashed reflection, born from a couple born from the remains of two previous failed relationships which they have not completely got over yet. Among discussions and theories on life, unfaithfulness is aired, terms and conditions to be fulfilled are written, a thousand concepts concerning love are defined...They love each other while actively focused on their previous loves. The least settled couple it could seem. And yet they find it difficult to break up. Could it be because they love each other six and a half?

title: Música y dinero
description: Empleados amenazan con iniciar una huelga y el jefe le pide ayuda a un amigo cantante que ha recibido una herencia.

title: Conecta y Canta
description: A musical reality show where music meets child and youth talent from all over Mexico.

title: Ayer y hoy
description: Two women from the same family, one from 1830 and the other from 1930, the first subject to the rigor of the customs of her time and the other in an atmosphere of independence and freedom.

title: Criada y señora
description: Aurora, una criada, asciende a concubina y queda embarazada. Traicionada, se protege con ayuda de su madre y la princesa, desenmascara conspiraciones y ayuda a Matías en la batalla. Esquivando atentados, se convierte en la esposa legítima. Juntos enfrentan la invasión del norte y, al vencer, logran por fin vivir en paz.

title: Juan y Vanesa
description: When Juan, a 35-year-old truck driver learns he has a daughter, he decides to become responsible. He quits alcohol and takes one last chance at his job, to deliver various goods to Mexico City. At a gas station, Vanesa, a Mexican Lolita with pink-dyed hair convinces Juan to let her go with him. A rebellious teenager and a broken man start a journey where they confront each other and their own demons only to realize that this strange encounter can awake something unexpected and beautiful in them.

title: Y Swn
description: In 1979, when Margaret Thatcher's first government breaks a promise to establish a Welsh language television channel, a wave of civil disobedience follows. One man - Gwynfor Evans - threatens to starve himself to death unless the government comes good on its manifesto pledge. The reimagining of one of the most colourful chapters in contemporary Welsh history.

title: Caprichosa y millonaria
description: The father of a rich girl sends an administrator to control his waste. A great comedy by Enrique Santos Discépolo.

title: Clara y Elena

title: Y que patatín, y que patatán
description: Five episodes that reflect a critical look on the universe of children. An ironic metaphor about the training of children and how they respond to limiting situations in their lives.

title: Clarines y campanas
description: Andrés, an altar boy in an asylum, dreams of becoming a bullfighter and falls in love with Carmen, the daughter of the owner of the farmhouse.

title: Sexo, mentiras y muertos
description: Viviana (Andrea Lopez) and Alicia (Martha Isabel Bolaños) have never met, but they're about to get intimately acquainted. One day, while tipping drinks back in a bar, the two women strike up a conversation that quickly turns personal, Viviana is locked in an abusive marriage, and Alicia's female lover, Lorena ('Carolina Sepulveda'), has recently fallen for another woman. As the two women strangers find common ground in their lives, they enter into a secret pact to kill the people who have made their lives a living hell. Seductive, bloody and shocking events send them both plummeting down a destructive path from which there is no escape.

title: Sal y Pimienta: El show de Flora y Hortensia
description: Two spinster old maids and perverts harass gallants and TV stars to marry them.

title: Rocío y José
description: José is a 17-year-old Andalusian boy who strikes up a relationship with a girl his age, Rocío, during the famous pilgrimage of the same name that takes place in the Huelva town of Almonte. In that place, accompanying the carts and horses, they strengthen their love as they walk the path that will take them to the hermitage where the Virgin is found.

title: Tito, Margot y yo
description: In front of the waves of the Panamanian Pacific in the town of El Higo, a woman walks and tells the story lived by the Panamanian Tito Arias and Margot Fonteyn, the most acclaimed dancer in the world and incomparable ballet figure.

title: Amor y Mentira
description: Andrea, una universitaria, quedó embarazada de Mario, quien fingió ser pobre por una apuesta. Al ser "condenado a muerte" (él era en realidad el Señor de la Guerra), Andrea se hizo cantante para salvarlo. Al descubrir la verdad, usó una máscara; Mario, sin reconocerla, la humilló. Demasiado tarde, entendió su error.

title: Y sin embargo se mueve
description: Julio Anguita, Ignacio Escolar, Pablo Iglesias, Nines Maestro, Miren Etxezarreta, Josep María Atentas, Esther Vivas, Diego Cañamero, José Coy, Ada Colau, Lluís Martí, Lola Domínguez, Juan Manuel Gordillo and Teresa Forcades. Voices for change. Cuts, unemployment, evictions, preferred stock, emigration, social exclusion, housing bubble, bailout, banks, caste, revolving doors, land tenure, privatization, deindustrialization. Economic war. Pioneers, Río Tinto, miners, La Canadiense strike, Andalusian Workers Union, day laborers, Sintel, Campamento de la Esperanza, 15M, Platform for People Affected by Mortgages, Ca Esperança, yayoflautas, Marinaleda, marches for dignity. Struggles that brought future.

title: El cura y el veneno
description:
SINOPSIS El Cura y el Veneno

Una fiesta lujosa en la Embajada Francesa de Madrid se convierte en el escenario de un crimen mortal. Las circunstancias misteriosas que rodean la muerte de un hombre influyente acaban convirtiendo a algunos de los propios invitados en sospechosos de asesinato. El crimen que, a primera vista, parece ser resuelto, empieza a tomar un movimiento serpentino que, poco a poco, ira destapando secretos guardados y deseos ocultos, poniendo de relieve las manifestaciones del veneno interior que todos llevamos dentro.

Felipe, un modesto cura y profesor de un colegio religioso, se ve implicado de forma inesperada en tales acontecimientos en los que el poder manda y el engaño impregna lo cotidiano.

Forzado a iniciar una investigación al margen de la ley, Felipe se hunde en un mundo oscuro donde se topara, cara a cara, con sus propios demonios que han regresado de un turbio pasado.

Este largometraje actual, con reminiscencias propias del clasico cine negro, posee una estética fuertemente expresiva y una estilización visual impactante que crean una atmósfera difusa, oscura, donde las apariencias engañan y la desconfianza reina.

Los espectadores se veran sumergidos en un mundo de misterio y una maraña de intriga y conflicto hasta llegar a la resolucion menos esperada.



 SYNOPSIS The Priest and the Poison

A glamorous reception at the French Embassy in Madrid becomes the scene of a deadly crime. The mysterious circumstances surrounding the death of an influential man of the French elite transform some of the guests into murder suspects. The crime, which at first glance seems so easily solved, takes on a serpentine movement that, little by little, uncovers well-kept secrets and hidden desires, the manifestations of a personal poison that we all carry within.

Felipe, an unassuming priest and teacher at a religious school for boys, finds himself caught up in a series of murders of political intrigue. Forced to begin an independent investigation outside the law, Felipe finds himself so immersed in this world of death and mistrust, that he is thrown face to face with his own dark past, from which he had tried so hard to escape.

This film resurrects the essence of classic film noir in a modern day context. With a strongly expressive and impacting aesthetic, this film creates an atmosphere of uncertainty, where appearances deceive and distrust reigns.

title: [Doblado]Tócala y arde
description: El día de mi compromiso, mi madre y yo estábamos en el carro esperando al chofer cuando la secretaria de mi prometido me mandó de pronto un video. En él, tenía a una loba de mediana edad tomada del cabello y le daba bofetada tras bofetada. "¡Selena, maldita interesada! ¿De verdad creíste que fingir ser una socialité y comprometerte con el Alfa Damián permitiría que tu madre se metiera a robar en su casa?" Otra bofetada cayó. El rostro de la mujer ya estaba horriblemente hinchado. "Típico de gente corriente. Siempre tomando lo ajeno. Como secretaria de Damián, me encargo de esta ladrona inmunda por él". Bajé lentamente el celular. A mi lado, mi madre se acomodaba el collar frente a su espejo compacto. Al notar que la miraba, sonrió y me acarició la mano. "La Manada Corona de Espinas puede ser un desastre en los negocios, cariño, pero Damián es guapísimo. Cuando la alianza sea oficial, tu padre y yo podremos arreglarlo todo". Frunciendo el ceño, reproduje el video otra vez. Los pómulos finos. El peinado impecable. Y el lunar en la oreja. Dios mío. ¡Era mi futura suegra, la señora Beltrán! Llamé de inmediato. "Vanessa, ¿tienes idea de lo idiota que eres? ¡Esa es la madre de Damián!" Ella soltó una risa cruel. "Ay, por favor. Damián ya me contó todo sobre ti. Una don nadie con la que su padre lo obligó a casarse. Ni siquiera le importas, así que ¿por qué le importaría tu familia?"

title: El rebelde y la erudita
description:
Elsa, una estudiante brillante que sufre de violencia doméstica y acoso escolar, solo quiere estudiar para huir. Escapando de los golpes de su padre, termina en "Fuego Salvaje", la tienda de tatuajes de Diego. Él es el chico malo de la escuela, pero en realidad es un heredero refugiado de su propia familia tóxica.
El destino los convierte en compañeros de banco. Pasando del odio a la confianza, ambos descubren las heridas del otro y se convierten en su salvación mutua.

description: After an unknown virus invades a co-ed boarding school, a group of high school students must band together and make one last-ditch effort to escape their infection-ridden campus.

title: Panienka z poste restante
description: Three years after the death of his wife, Waldemar still cannot forget her. Lucia is a woman in love with Waldemar, and Bohdan Michorowski is in love with Lucia... but so is Count Brochwicz! The two men come head to head during a New Year`s Eve party, and Waldemar has to step in to avert disaster. Minely trzy lata od smierci ukochanej Waldemara, Stefci. Ordynat nie moze o niej zapomniec. Kocha sie w nim, bez wzajemnosci, Lucia. W niej zas zakochany jest Bohdan Michorowski. O reke Luci stara sie rowniez hrabia Brochwicz. Na balu sylwestrowym dochodzi do scysji pomiedzy Brochwiczem i Bohdanem Michorowskim. Bohdan wyzywa go na pojedynek, ale Waldemar, jako glowa rodziny, korzysta z prawa pierwszenstwa i staje na placu boju zamiast Bohdana. Zwycieza. Lucia i Bohdan postanawiaja sie pobrac, a ordynat mianuje go swoim nastepca. Wykorzystujac powodzenie Tredowatej Henryk Szaro sfilmowal dalszy ciag tej powiesci. Ordynat Michorowski zostal zrealizowany w konwencji dramatu z wyzszych sfer, z elementami sensacji. Prezentuje on przecietny poziom komercyjnych filmow tamtego okresu.

title: Z Storm
description: This is a story about the biggest financial fraud attempted in Hong Kong, directed at the Government of Hong Kong and involved all 7 million Hong Kong citizens... no one is free from the scheme. Within the four decades of guarding Hong Kong's financial integrity, the ICAC has never come across an opponent so huge and so well organized as in the Z Torrent file... shadowy figures from the underworld of South America, Italy and Europe all ready to plot against the estimated 150 million dollars of Hong Kong citizens' tax money which was pooled in a fund called the WELFARE FUND. High profile chartered accountants, high ranking law enforcers, power lawyers, the super entrepreneurs; they all have their shares of play but none can really grasp the big picture; they are there only for what they desire most. When the wife of an up-rising star Superintendent of police force reported his corruption simply out of bitterness for being ill-treated, little did she know she is about to pull the head string from a very well weaved web of deceive, greed, sex, power, and last but not least, fear. The ICAC agent LOK who took charge of the simple complaint felt otherwise... it's his passion for justice that has been driving him all these years in the battle against bribery and corruption, even after losing his beloved wife. Further investigation soon revealed many unanswered questions and loose ends...the death of an ex-godfather status accountant of Hong Kong, the threats to even the seemingly harmless witnesses and informers, and the surfacing of a mysterious lady that has all connection with LOK's wanted list but with a background as simple and as tragic as a girl next door with terminal illness... As Lok dug deeper into the web, he is being hunted by trained foreign mercenaries; a tactic very seldom or never heard of in the history of Hong Kong's underworld! With the support of his superior the old but streetwise Deputy Chief of ICAC, Lok eventually unlocked the door to the plan, but only after a bloodbath gun battle that almost cost him his life and that of the attractive mysterious woman, Angel.

title: Zero Hour
description: Set in the isolated trenches of W.W.I, Zero Hour is the tale of a young British Officer confronted with shocking discoveries about his newly assigned Company in Northern France. In his quest for duty and honor, Lieutenant Oliver Enfield decides to set things right by taking matters into his own hands. On the eve of a major offensive, Lieutenant Enfield embarks on an unauthorized reconnaissance mission. Instead of finding answers he undergoes a harsh but fantastical journey of transformation, which ultimately leads him to question his own sanity and purpose. At a turning point in his existence he must answer the question-Does an officer's duty to country demand blind loyalty? Or can it be an opportunity to save his men from one of the most futile advances of the First World War.

title: Megaquake 10.0
description: Scientists offer insight into how and where a 10.0 megaquake could strike. This two-hour History special explores one of the most deadly and perplexing mysteries that surrounds planet earth: huge megaquakes. The largest quake ever recorded was a 9.5 earthquake off of Chile in 1960, but new research shows how even larger quakes close to 10.0 just might be possible. Through interviews with top earthquake experts and cutting edge scientific experiments, the special reveals that over 3 billion people on earth are in immediate danger from the next big one and how a real 10.0 might actually happen on US soil--in places you might not expect.

title: Project Zero Awakens
description: Genesis Tech has spent years conducting illegal experiments to create the ultimate human weapon. Zero, its most successful subject, escapes during the final trial, forcing the company to destroy the entire island facility. Three years later, he is rescued by sisters Amy and Emil. As his memories return, Zero begins a deadly hunt for his creators—while the leaked experimental serum threatens to unleash a far greater disaster...

The fact that he functions as an anime character in a normal toon world is the source of much confusion and comedy. Life will never be the same again, and as our leads discover, it is far more exciting this way.

All sign ups are done on our facebook group only

title: Power of 1
description: Izu Ojukwu's Power of 1 is now available on Amazon Prime Video for viewers in the US and UK. The political thriller, which is partly inspired by 2 Baba's shelved 2017 protests stars Alexx Ekubo in the lead role of Justin Aba, a socially conscious afro-pop artiste with a large following. When Justin Aba decides to use his influence to stage a protest against the policies of the incumbent government, he is drawn into a game of politics he didn't bargain for. This film shows the twists, turns, and intrigue of a proposed protest march called by an influential pop artiste, that shook the socio-political landscape of Nigeria to its very foundation. Nerves are stretched to breaking point as the decision to take ownership and execute the protest throws up intriguing reactions from security operatives, political players, hustlers and opportunists Power of 1 stars Ramsey Nouah, Anne Idibia, Jide Kosoko and Michelle Dede. The film was released in cinemas nationwide last December and has played in theatres in the UK and US.

title: Daitarn 3
description: Sozo Haran was a scientist living on Mars, who created a form of self-aware cyborgs (the Meganoids). The Meganoids rebelled and killed Dr. Haran and his family, except his son, the 16-year-old Banjo Haran. Banjo escapes from Mars with a super robot called Daitarn 3, built with the Mars special metals. Living on Earth, Banjo fights against the Meganoids together with his butler Garrison and the two girls Reika and Beauty, in attempt of preventing the Meganoids from converting the human race into cyborgs.

title: 3 NIGHT AND 3 BABIES
description:
SYNOPSIS : Judith (Georgina Ibeh) suffers so much pressure, and swallows very bitter insults from her mother in-law (Phyl Daniels) because she is still unable to get pregnant two years into her marriage. She joins forces with her mother in-law to convince her husband Laurel (Bryan Okwara) into taking a second wife. Laurel finally agrees, but this second wife, Nancy (Ibiwari Etuk) is not about to follow their mother in-law's guide and footsteps. The drama that unfolds afterwards drives Judith out of the house and almost shatter's Laurel's world. When she returns months after heavily pregnant, eyebrows are raised and questions are asked. Time will prove, if the babies Judith is carrying truly belong to Laurel or not.
